title: Test Structure & Lifecycle
description: Master test suite organization with setup/teardown mechanisms, tags for filtering, templates for data-driven testing, and suite-level configuration.
learningObjectives: Use Suite Setup and Suite Teardown for one-time initialization and cleanup
Apply Test Setup and Test Teardown for per-test state management
Organize tests with tags for selective execution and filtering
Implement data-driven testing using test templates
Define suite-level variables in the Variables section
Set test timeouts to prevent runaway tests
Use Force Tags to apply tags to entire test suites
Understand test execution lifecycle and order

keyTakeaways: Suite Setup runs once before all tests; Test Setup runs before each test
Suite Teardown runs once after all tests; Test Teardown runs after each test
Teardown always runs, even if setup or tests fail
Tags enable selective test execution with --include and --exclude
Force Tags applies to all tests in suite; individual [Tags] are additive
[Template] enables data-driven testing with keyword templates
Variables section defines suite-level variables accessible to all tests
Setup/teardown hierarchy: Suite Setup → Test Setup → Test → Test Teardown → Suite Teardown
Use Suite Setup for expensive initialization; Test Setup for test isolation
commonPitfalls: Forgetting Suite Teardown runs even if Suite Setup fails
Using Suite Setup when tests need isolation (should use Test Setup)
Not cleaning up state between tests when using Suite Setup
Setting timeout too low, causing valid tests to fail
Forgetting [Template] requires data rows, not keyword calls
Defining variables in wrong scope (test vs suite vs global)
Not handling Suite Setup failures gracefully

realWorldApplications.description: Use Suite Setup to connect to database once, Test Teardown to rollback changes, Suite Teardown to disconnect
Suite Setup for authentication token generation, Force Tags for API test categorization, Test Timeout for network operations
Suite Setup to open browser once, Test Setup to reset to home page, tags for smoke/regression filtering
Use templates to test login with multiple credential sets, form validation with various inputs
Tag smoke tests for fast pipelines, regression for nightly builds, critical for deployment gates
